mails.subject: Demande de renseignements : location d'une salle à la journée
mails.body:
Madame, Monsieur,

Le Cercle des Métiers du Nord organise chaque année une journée de travail réunissant une vingtaine de membres. Nous souhaiterions savoir s'il est possible de louer l'une de vos salles pour une journée complète. La date n'est pas encore arrêtée.

Pourriez-vous nous indiquer vos tarifs, la capacité de vos salles ainsi que les conditions de réservation ?

Dans l'attente de votre réponse, nous vous prions d'agréer, Madame, Monsieur, l'expression de nos salutations distinguées.

Claire Dubois
Secrétaire générale
mails.justification: A visitor organisation formally asks whether a room can be rented for a day with no date, so room_booking, answer within the week.

mails.subject: Re: Co-branded sustainability week at Stenbro Hub
mails.body:
Hi Elsebeth,

Thanks for the quick answer, and for sharing the numbers on your community. That is very useful.

To be concrete about what Grønne Tider would like to propose: a sustainability week in the first half of November, with three evening talks hosted in your space, a shared logo on the programme and the posters, and a short article on our magazine website about your community. We would cover printing, speaker fees and a light dinner for the first evening. In return we would ask for the room, basic AV and a mention in your own newsletter.

Our editor would also like to interview one or two of your members who work in climate or circular economy. If you have names in mind, we would be glad to hear them.

If this sounds interesting, we could sketch the programme together in a call. I am free most afternoons next week. We have no fixed deadline, but we would like to publish the dates by the end of October.

Best wishes,
Maja Kristiansen
Partnerships, Grønne Tider

> On 9 Oct, Elsebeth wrote: We would be happy to talk about a co-branded week, tell us what you have in mind.
mails.justification: An organisation follows up on a co-branded event week and press piece, so partnership, no immediate deadline, a reply is expected.

mails.subject: Bruit et climatisation au 3e étage
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Depuis lundi, la ventilation du troisième étage fait un bruit continu qui rend les appels difficiles. Plusieurs personnes de mon équipe sont gênées. De plus, la salle de pause n'a pas été nettoyée depuis mardi.

Pouvez-vous faire intervenir quelqu'un d'ici demain ou après-demain ?

Par ailleurs, une amie qui dirige une petite association souhaiterait organiser un atelier d'écriture chez vous le mois prochain. Dois-je lui donner votre adresse mail ou y a-t-il un formulaire ?

Merci,
Julien Perrin
mails.justification: A member complains about noise and cleaning and asks for a quick fix, with a passing mention of a workshop next month, so complaint, 24-hour urgency.

mails.subject: Locked out + lost scarf
mails.body:

Unrelated: I think I left a grey wool scarf in the phone booth last week. Has anyone handed one in?

Thanks,
Priya

mails.subject: thanks!!
mails.body:
Hi all,

Just wanted to say thanks, I have been a member for 2 months now and it has honestly changed how I work. Before I was at my kitchen table all day, now I actually see people. The standing desks by the window are great and the coffee corner is also very good.

Also FYI because someone asked me last week, the key code for the bike room is still the old one, I tried it this morning and it worked, so no worries there.

One thing I sstill wanted to tell you: I will be at the Thursday lunch every week from now on so save me a seat :)

No need to reply to this, I know you are busy. Have a good weekend
Emil

Sent from my phone

> On 12 Oct, team wrote: Welcome to the community, hope you enjoy the desks!
mails.justification: A member sends thanks and a harmless FYI with nothing asked, so other, urgency 1, no reply needed.

mails.subject: Found items: umbrella and laptop charger, floor 2
mails.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

During the cleaning of the building on 13 October, our staff found a black umbrella and a laptop charger (USB-C, 65 W) on the second floor, near the stairwell. We understand that this floor is occupied by your community.

We have stored the items at our reception desk, open on weekdays between 8:00 and 16:00. Could you kindly let us know whether the items belong to one of your members, or whether you would prefer that we bring them to your reception?

Should no one claim them within thirty days, we are obliged to dispose of them in accordance with our internal procedure.

We thank you in advance for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,
Per Sundholm
Property Administration, Sundholm Ejendomme
mails.justification: The landlord asks the space about found items, a question that fits no other category, so other, within the week, reply needed.
